context.reason: The inline index approached the GitHub Contents API boundary. Historical arrays are externalized into immutable shards; the pre-migration ledger remains in Git history.

decision: Replace inline sources/run_updates/limitations arrays with archive_pointer objects. Each shard stores ordered records and is referenced by path, Git blob SHA, chunk index/count and record count. A backward-compatible read-only validator resolves legacy inline arrays and sharded pointers.
preservation: No source/run-update/limitation records are discarded; concatenated archive records must equal prior arrays exactly.
All prior snapshots and graph addenda remain unchanged.
The pre-migration ledger remains in the parent commit and Git history.
Dedicated research branch only; no main write or merge.
required_tests: Sharded arrays reconstruct exactly in original order.
Git blob hashes verify for every shard.
Missing shard, bad digest, path traversal, count mismatch and duplicate source IDs fail closed.
Latest snapshot pointer and source references resolve.
digest_algorithm: Git blob SHA-1 over exact shard bytes
